name: Basecamp
label: Basecamp 3 API
description: Official Basecamp 3/4 API via OfficialApiNode (nodes/basecamp/api_spec.json). extraHeaders send required User-Agent: {user_agent} (app name + contact). Official docs: https://github.com/basecamp/bc3-api. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Basecamp official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"project_list"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'project_list', 'project_get', 'todo_create', 'todo_get', 'todo_complete', 'todo_list_create', 'message_create', 'document_create', 'comment_create', 'person_list', 'campfire_line', 'schedule_entry', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'project_list'.

schema.label: account_id
schema.description: Basecamp account id path (from /my/profile.json). Example: 1234567.

schema.label: project_id
schema.description: Project id path for every project-scoped op.

schema.label: vault_id
schema.description: Vault id path for document_create (POST …/vaults/{vault_id}/documents.json). Example: 789.

schema.label: message_board_id
schema.description: Message board id path for message_create (POST …/message_boards/{message_board_id}/messages.json). Example: 456.

schema.label: todoset_id
schema.description: Todoset id path for todo_list_create (POST …/todosets/{todoset_id}/todolists.json). Example: 123.

schema.label: todolist_id
schema.description: Todolist id path for todo_create.

schema.label: content
schema.description: Todo title (todo_create), HTML body (message_create / document_create / comment_create), or campfire line (campfire_line). Example: Ship the invoice.

schema.label: due_on
schema.description: Todo due date YYYY-MM-DD for todo_create. Example: 2026-12-01.

schema.label: todo_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `todo_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Todolist or schedule name when that op uses it.

schema.label: description
schema.description: Todolist description.

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Message subject for message_create. Example: Standup notes.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Document title for document_create. Example: Runbook.

schema.label: recording_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `recording_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: chat_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `chat_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: schedule_id
schema.description: Request field for operations that declare `schedule_id` as a path, query, or JSON body key. Omitted/blank is dropped. Example: 'example-value'.

schema.label: summary
schema.description: Schedule entry summary.

schema.label: starts_at
schema.description: Schedule entry start ISO-8601.

schema.label: ends_at
schema.description: Schedule entry end ISO-8601.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: project_list, project_get, todo_create, todo_get, todo_complete, todo_list_create, message_create, document_create, comment_create, person_list, campfire_line, schedule_entry, listen. Default: project_list. Example: project_list.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: Provider credential for auth.type=bearer (configKey access_token). REQUIRED secret — StudioQuack secret binding only; never put this on INPUT. Never logged. Example: 'redacted-token'.

configurationParameters.label: Account Id
configurationParameters.description: Default Basecamp account id when INPUT account_id is empty. From GET /my/profile.json.

configurationParameters.label: User Agent
configurationParameters.description: Required BC3 User-Agent: application name plus a contact URL or email. Missing this header returns HTTP 400. Example: 'StudioQuack (ops@example.com)'.

configurationParameters.label: Todoset Id
configurationParameters.description: Todoset id path for todo_list_create (POST …/todosets/{todoset_id}/todolists.json). Example: 123.

configurationParameters.label: Message Board Id
configurationParameters.description: Message board id path for message_create (POST …/message_boards/{message_board_id}/messages.json). Example: 456.

configurationParameters.label: Vault Id
configurationParameters.description: Vault id path for document_create (POST …/vaults/{vault_id}/documents.json). Example: 789.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for the official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Blank/0/negative → 25. Example: 25.
